findings.summary: Failure-first proof does not cover all required registered Slack identity API denials.
findings.details: The task packet requires forged/replayed/expired link token, wrong team/user, display-name/email match, already-bound identity, revoked WorkOS user/membership, stale connection generation, and token logging proof. The tests cover expired, replay, wrong-team, and already-bound behavior only through consumeSlackIdentityLinkPlan, and the registered Confect mutation path exercises forged nonce, wrong team, replay, workspace removal, suspended pending consume, manual lifecycle revoke, and stale generation. There is still no registered-path proof for expired nonce, Slack wrong-user/already-bound activation, display-name/email spoof attempts, or revoked organization membership before consume. Because the public/internal Confect mutations are the contract boundary used by Slack intake/settings, helper-only coverage can false-green while the auth/database API diverges.
